events.title: Clean Harbors (CLH) Beats Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: Clean Harbors (CLH) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +3.25% and -0.38%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Clean Harbors raises guidance after record-high Q1 revenue
events.body: The company said landfill volumes increased 34% year over year in part due to PFAS-related project work. Other segments also outperformed expectations, prompting Clean Harbors to raise full-year guidance.

events.title: Clean Harbors (NYSE:CLH) Reports Sales Below Analyst Estimates In Q1 CY2026 Earnings
events.body: Environmental and industrial services company Clean Harbors (NYSE:CLH) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026 as sales only rose 1.9% year on year to $1.46 billion. Its GAAP profit of $1.19 per share was 4.8% above analysts’

events.title: Amprius Technologies Set to Report Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
events.body: AMPX heads into Q1 results with strong revenue growth expectations, fueled by battery demand, NDAA tailwinds and expanding market traction.
